transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... just really stressed out, I guess. 

It’s... mostly about my dad. Well, his lab results. I draw blood for a living, so I know what I'm looking at. And for the past year, I’ve been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is... changing his numbers. Or holding parts of the results back. 

My family and the doctors keep telling me everything is fine, but... I know the chart doesn’t match what I actually saw. It’s just... it's wearing me down.
Do you believe for certain that someone in the clinic system is changing or hiding your dad’s lab results?

I mean... yes. I know what I saw. I do this for a living, so... I know when something's missing. They can say whatever they want, but the numbers in the chart aren't the whole picture. I just... I know it.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?
No. I don't... I don't have anything like that going on. I just look at the charts. That's all.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking your dad’s lab records over and over, even when you try not to?
I mean... I check them when I need to. Just to see if anything changed. But it's not... I'm not doing it all the time. Just when I have to.
If someone showed you clear proof that your dad’s lab results were never changed, would you believe it?

I... I don't know what you mean by proof. For the last year, everyone—my family, the doctors here—they all keep telling me the numbers are fine. 

But... the chart doesn't match what I saw. I've been trying to prove it for a year, and... it's just wearing me down. So... I don't know. I just know what I saw.
Has this situation caused problems for you at work?

I mean... maybe. I feel like... at work, they aren't really considering me for lab supervision anymore. I guess some people think I make record issues too confrontational. And... it's not just work. My family has started leaving me out when they plan his appointments. So... yeah. I guess it has.
Do you think anyone is trying to harm, monitor, or deceive you in other parts of your life besides your dad’s lab results?
No. Not really. I mean... I still go to my shifts at the clinic. I pay my rent. I... I take care of my own stuff. Everything else is just... normal. It's just this one thing with his records.
Do you think it’s possible that you might be mistaken about your dad’s lab results?

I... no. I'm not mistaken. 

I know what I saw. I've spent a year trying to prove it. Someone in the clinic system is changing them, or... holding parts of it back. It doesn't matter how many times my family or the doctors tell me the numbers are fine. The chart doesn't match. I just... I know I'm not wrong about this.
